column1: Seller pays everything: your buyer pays the order total, and the card provider's fee and the 2% Caravel fee come off what you receive. Split: the card provider's fee is added to your buyer's total, and you pay the 2% Caravel fee. Buyer pays everything: the 2% Caravel fee is added to your buyer's total too, so you receive the full order total.
